dimensions.assessment: Affects federal employees at the SEC and GSA, and GAO personnel.
Administrative change in which agency handles real estate leasing.
dimensions.evidence: revokes the authority of the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) to lease general purpose office space and instead provides for the General Services Administration to lease such space for the SEC

dimensions.assessment: The source material mentions no federal spending or revenue changes.
Amends title 40, United States Code, to eliminate SEC independent leasing authority.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title 40, United States Code, to eliminate the leasing authority of the Securities and Exchange Commission

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory amendment regarding leasing responsibilities.
dimensions.evidence: on and after the date of enactment of this subsection, the Securities and Exchange Commission may not lease general purpose office space

missing_information: Exact cost estimates or savings from transferring leasing duties.
Number of leases or square footage affected.
importance_detail.rationale: This bill makes minor, administrative changes to agency leasing authorities by transferring SEC general purpose office space leasing duties to the General Services Administration and ordering a GAO update report.
